summary: Verified Per-Manager Configurable Filters / Sub-Tabs / Spec Fields feature. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_manager_config_per_manager.py covering (1) GET with_defaults=true seeds non-empty filter_facets/sub_tabs/spec_fields for all 6 built-in slugs (tiles/materials/flooring/bathroom/underfloor_heating/tools), (2) PATCH filter_facets on materials adds Warranty & is isolated from tiles (tiles labels unchanged), (3) PATCH sub_tabs on tools persists, (4) PATCH spec_fields on flooring persists, (5) unauthenticated PATCH → 403, (6) unknown slug PATCH → 404. All PATCH bodies must include a `key` field on each facet/tab/spec — Pydantic model enforces it (this is correct). Frontend E2E: logged in as admin@test.com, opened Configure modal on all 6 built-in managers (/admin/materials, /tiles, /flooring, /bathroom, /underfloor-heating, /tools) — each mounts [data-testid=manager-config-modal] with 3 tabs (config-tab-filters/subTabs/specs) and correct badge counts. Materials default: Filters 4, Sub-Categories 6, Spec Fields 5 (matches expected). E2E add-flow: clicked config-add-facet on materials, filled Warranty/warranty, config-save-all → toast 'Manager config updated' fired, modal closed. Reopened → 5 facets, Warranty at idx 4. Navigated to /admin/tiles → 6 default facets [Colour, Finish, Material, Size, Slip, Supplier], NO Warranty → isolation verified. Cleanup: removed Warranty via config-facet-remove-4 + save → materials restored to 4 facets.
